claims: Continue mechanical ventilation weaning with spontaneous breathing trial assessment and monitor respiratory status.
Monitor hemodynamics with arterial line and pulmonary artery catheter, including cardiac output and blood pressure.
Monitor and manage temporary pacemaker settings and rhythm.
Monitor blood glucose and continue insulin infusion per protocol.
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit; transfuse if clinically indicated.

Monitor electrolytes including potassium, magnesium, and ionized calcium; replace as needed.
Continue analgesia and sedation with fentanyl, titrating to Richmond-RAS goal of 0.
Perform tracheostomy care and subglottal suctioning.
Reposition and provide skin care per Braden scale, with chairfast activity as tolerated.
